#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue with the password reset email containing a localhost link is caused by how the base URL is set in the email template generation code. In `src/notifications/templates.ts`, the base URL for links uses the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL` if set, falling back to `http://localhost:3000` otherwise:

```typescript
const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
```

If the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL` is not configured correctly in the running environment (for example, not set in production), the email links will default to a localhost address, which is not accessible externally.

The fix is to ensure the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL` is properly set to the public-facing URL of the application in deployment configurations. Alternatively, the code or configuration could be adjusted to use a more robust method for determining the public URL.

This code and configuration pattern explains the problem after the last release if `PUBLIC_URL` was not set or was removed from environment configs.
